tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Dark theme is a deep DGA navy, not black.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternating page bands, sidebars, table stripes.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Input fills, image placeholders, quiet panels. ink-muted does NOT reach 4.5:1 here in light theme; use ink-secondary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-subtle and surface-muted. In light theme it is DGA navy, the site's main text colour.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy in dense UI and article paragraphs, on surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, captions, metadata; on surface and surface-subtle only (4.95:1 / 6.38:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not meaning-bearing).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (source value). Light #c1c1c1 is 1.8:1 on white, below the 3:1 floor for control borders: kept exact from dga.or.th; pair inputs with a label and the focus ring.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: DGA navy (the 'A' of the logo). Footer, hero bands, cover and section-divider slides. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a navy fill (16.6:1).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: DGA orange, the brand colour (logo 'DG'). Fills, large headings 24px+ (3.54:1 on white), graphics, and text on navy (4.69:1). Never small body text on white.

tokens.name: orange-strong
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active nav text, focus ring. Text on surface (4.53:1 light / 7.06:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Label on an orange-strong fill (4.53:1 light / 7.06:1 dark).

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind active nav items and highlighted rows. Source pairs orange-strong text here at 4.22:1 (below 4.5:1 for 14.72px nav text): kept exact; bold 19px+ passes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 4.53:1 on white, 7.06:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and 'อ่านต่อ' read-more links.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed / on-track status. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: At-risk / pending status. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error / off-track. Keep visibly distinct from brand orange by pairing with an icon and the word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notices and neutral status.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series (navy). Charts in decks and reports.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series / the highlighted series (orange).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series (navy tint). 3.46:1 on white, 5.27:1 on dark: fine for marks, label it directly.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: 'Other' / baseline / comparison bars. Carries no meaning on its own.
